raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly expanded the scope of the “Battle of Palembang” to include a later phase (often referred to as a separate action on 24 February 1942) and concluded the end date as 24 February. This contradicted the evidence surfaced by WebSurfer showing the battle dates as 13–15 February 1942 on Wikipedia. By conflating multiple engagements and not adhering to the commonly defined battle timeframe, the Planner provided the wrong end date instead of the correct 15 February 1942.
